quotedPost.originalText:
$499,235 of unbilled work across 1000 work orders. @NaceAI's drex found $482,260.

i recently came across drex, an alternative to @typesafeai jev and quickly built this to try things out for a client demo

the problem: technicians write down everything they did, but the invoice often misses some of it. that work never gets paid for.

drex reads the note and the invoice and flags what's missing. code does the math. when drex isn't sure, a human decides.

it got 15 wrong ($5,435). 59 went to a human.

live: https://t.co/RfhJSF4pCW
